title: GTA6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Songs and Real-World Artists
description: Grand Theft Auto 6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed, featuring 34 original tracks and real-world artists, with six tracks available to stream today.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Original Soundtrack Revealed: 34 Tracks and Real-World Collaborations

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6, new details regarding the open-world crime game's audio landscape have surfaced. According to a recent report by media outlet Eurogamer, the original soundtrack for GTA 6 has been partially revealed, giving fans an exciting first look at the music behind the highly anticipated title.

## A Massive Musical Scope

According to the information, the full album for the upcoming game will contain a total of 34 original tracks specifically created for the title. Rockstar Games has a legendary history of crafting immersive audio experiences that define gaming generations, and the inclusion of music from multiple real-world artists suggests that this tradition will continue in full force. While full details are still emerging, the scale of a 34-song original soundtrack highlights the immense production value being poured into the project.

## Stream Six Tracks Today

In an exciting move for fans of the franchise, six of these tracks are already available to stream today. Listeners can dive into the newly released music right now to get a taste of the sonic atmosphere that will accompany players through the streets of the game's open world.

## Editor's Take
Music has always been the heartbeat of the Grand Theft Auto franchise. Unveiling a 34-track original soundtrack featuring real-world artists shows Rockstar's commitment to top-tier production. Dropping six tracks to stream immediately is a brilliant way to build hype and keep the community engaged.
